output.reason: [ev-5bbbbea35c34] lists this under "Warnings and breaking changes" and says the `crossplane xpkg login` and `crossplane xpkg logout` commands have been removed from the Crossplane CLI. So any script or CI workflow that still calls them to log in before pushing a package breaks, which is an integration failure (workload-failure), not a changed default that keeps working. The suggested replacements (`docker login`, `docker/login-action`) are outside tools the user must switch to, not an upstream mechanism that takes over the function, so superseded-upstream does not fit. The proposed remediation and medium severity match the evidence.
